mapper.insert: INSERT INTO v5ai_conversation_summary (conversation_id, summary, covered_until_message_id, covered_messages, model_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{conversationId}, #{summary}, #{coveredUntilMessageId}, #{coveredMessages}, #{modelId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON CONFLICT (conversation_id) DO UPDATE SET summary = EXCLUDED.summary, covered_until_message_id = EXCLUDED.covered_until_message_id, covered_messages = EXCLUDED.covered_messages, model_id = EXCLUDED.model_id, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE v5ai_conversation_summary.covered_until_message_id < EXCLUDED.covered_until_message_id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM v5ai_conversation_summary WHERE conversation_id IN (SELECT id FROM v5ai_conversation WHERE agent_key = #{agentKey})
